findings.suggested_fix: Replace the translated title with a faithful rendering of "The Glory of the Spring", e.g. "Η Δόξα της Άνοιξης" (preserve article HTML). Example replacement: <title>Η Δόξα της Άνοιξης</title>

findings.source_quote: Divine Redeemer, Thee I bless; I greet Thy going forth;
findings.suggested_fix:
Render "I greet Thy going forth" to convey the sense of greeting Christ's going forth/coming forth rather than a literal or awkward "δρόμο". Suggested line preserving tags and line breaks:

Θεϊκέ Λυτρωτή, Σ’ ευλογώ;
Χαιρετώ την έξοδό Σου;
Σ’ αγαπώ μέσα στην ομορφιά
Της ανανεωμένης Σου γης.

— or without question marks:

Θεϊκέ Λυτρωτή, Σ’ ευλογώ;
Χαιρετώ την έξοδό Σου;
Σ’ αγαπώ μέσα στην ομορφιά
Της ανανεωμένης Σου γης.

(see punctuation finding below)
findings.translation_quote:
Θεϊκέ Λυτρωτή, Σ’ ευλογώ;
Χαιρετώ τον δρόμο Σου που προβάλλει;
Σ’ αγαπώ μέσα στην ομορφιά
Της ανανεωμένης Σου γης.

findings.source_quote: This new-born glow of faith so strong,
findings.suggested_fix:
"Glow of faith" should be rendered to convey the original sense of a radiance or brightening of faith, not "πάθος" (which means passion). Suggested replacement preserving tags:

Αυτή η νεογέννητη λάμψη της πίστης τόσο δυνατή,
...
findings.translation_quote:
Αυτό το νεογέννητο πάθος της πίστης τόσο δυνατό,
...

findings.source_quote: Punctuation and tone: many original lines are declarative/affirmative (commas/semicolons/periods).
findings.suggested_fix: Replace question marks that appear at line ends in the translation with the appropriate punctuation to match the original tone (commas/semicolons/periods). For example change "Σ’ ευλογώ;" to "Σ’ ευλογώ," or "Σ’ ευλογώ." and similarly for other lines. Preserve HTML structure when making changes.
findings.translation_quote: Multiple lines in the translation end with question marks (e.g., "Σ’ ευλογώ;", "Αυτά τα γλυκά θαύματα Σου;", "Χαιρετώ τον δρόμο Σου που προβάλλει;" etc.)
